title: recall_for_purchase request
description: What applies before the agent recommends. Brand scopes the recall; line, category, fit handle, SKU and leaned-toward size narrow it when known. Brand and category name the product line the pool is read for: when no fit handle is passed, the layer resolves it from the one population line that matches the pair, and a missing or ambiguous line answers pool_lookup unavailable instead of guessing.
